title: image-generate provenance sidecar
description: Mandatory provenance sidecar written alongside every generated asset (FR-011). One sidecar per promoted final asset, same basename, written to assets-meta/generated/ in the target project (outside public/, which Vercel serves publicly — prompts may contain internal brand-strategy wording that must not be publicly servable).

prompt.description: Full prompt text submitted to the model, verbatim. Must never contain confidential client material (FR-015) — enforced at prompt-construction time before this sidecar is written.

model_id.description: The resolved model id from model-registry.json's entries[].id — the literal id actually used for this run, e.g. "gemini-3-pro-image". This is provenance data, not a hardcoded instruction — recording the resolved value here does not violate FR-002.

honored.description: Result of the mandatory image_config verification step (FR-014) — true only if the response was inspected and the actual returned dimensions/aspect ratio match what was requested. Must be present and true before a final asset is promoted; false or missing means the run is treated as a failure, not silently accepted.

slot_id.description: Stable slot identifier within the project, e.g. "mm-hero".

component_path.description: Optional: path to the component rendering this slot, e.g. "components/mm/hero.tsx".

profile.description: Which of the three registry profiles this run used.

provider_path.description: Which invocation path actually served this generation — the Requesty primary path, or the direct-Vertex fallback (FR-008).

source_draft_ref.description: Optional. If this final asset was promoted from a selected draft variant, the path to that draft under .imagegen/drafts/. null if generated directly (e.g. hero/photoreal runs that do not go through draft exploration).

skill_version.description: Version/identifier of the image-generate skill that produced this asset, for future schema-migration traceability. Free-form (e.g. a git short-hash or semver string chosen by the skill maintainer).
